description: UK (rest of UK rates, 2026/27): the tax deducted from a first flexible pension withdrawal taken as an uncrystallised funds pension lump sum (25% tax-free, 75% taxed on the emergency code, month 1 basis: £1,048 allowance and one twelfth of each band, per HMRC PAYE76170), the tax actually due for the year given other income, the refund, and the HMRC form (PAYE94055: P55 part of the pot; P50Z whole pot and no other PAYE income; P53Z whole pot with a job or other pensions).
